info.title: The panel vocabulary: families, widgets, display kinds, display axes, display sources and placements of a panel

PANEL_FAMILIES.description: The panel families of a plugin (omx-panel docs/panel-layout.md): the kind of processor its panel is laid out for. The words and their order are the contract; omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs FAMILIES and the skin package schema read them, and keep their code.
PANEL_FAMILIES.x-why: Panel families and widgets are declarations, so they live here (vocabulary-owner rule, FreeMixer/omx-contract#157).

oneOf.description: a plugin with no family: its panel is laid out from its groups and roles
oneOf.x-text: A plugin with no family: its panel is laid out from its groups and its roles.

PANEL_DISPLAY_KINDS.description: The displays a declared panel may carry, and the extension serves (org.openmixer.panel-description/1), in the order of their codes: a panel description names a display by its place here. omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs and omx-clap-core's panel tables read them, and keep their code.
PANEL_DISPLAY_KINDS.x-why: omx-clap-core restated these words by hand beside the families and widgets; a display kind is a declaration, so it lives here (vocabulary-owner rule).

oneOf.x-text: The dynamics transfer curve: output level against input level.

PANEL_DISPLAY_SOURCES.x-why: omx-clap-core and omx-plugins restated these words by hand beside the families, widgets and display kinds; a display source is a declaration, so it lives here (vocabulary-owner rule).

PANEL_STORE_CODES.description: The refusals of the descriptions store's reader and writer (omx-panel docs/descriptions-store.md, section 5): each is the qualification store's code of the same name, with panel-store. for its prefix. The loader's own codes are passed through, not repeated here.

oneOf.title: absent
oneOf.description: the base file does not exist
oneOf.x-text: The base store file does not exist.

oneOf.title: unreadable
oneOf.description: a layer exists and SQLite cannot open or read it
oneOf.x-text: A store file exists and cannot be read.

oneOf.title: notAStore
oneOf.description: a file at version 0, with no store_info row, or of another layer than the place it was opened as
oneOf.x-text: The file is not a store of the layer it was opened as.

oneOf.title: schemaMismatch
oneOf.description: the opened files are at different schema versions
oneOf.x-text: The store files are at different schema versions.

oneOf.title: schemaOther
oneOf.description: a file is at a schema version other than the reader's
oneOf.x-text: A store file is at another schema version than the reader's.

oneOf.title: domainTooOld
oneOf.description: an installed domain is older than the version a store was checked against
oneOf.x-text: An installed domain is older than the one the store was checked against.

oneOf.title: wordUnknown
oneOf.description: a stored word is in none of the items its column is checked against
oneOf.x-text: A stored word is in none of the items its column is checked against.

oneOf.title: hotJournal

oneOf.x-text: A layer has a hot journal: its writer stopped inside a transaction.

oneOf.title: busy

oneOf.x-text: A layer stayed locked past the timeout.

oneOf.description: a put whose JSON is not an entry of the description schema, or whose words are not in their items
oneOf.x-text: The entry is not an entry of the description schema, or holds a word its item lacks.

PANEL_DESCRIBE_CODES.description: The refusals describe states for a plugin (omx-panel tools/describe.mjs DESCRIBE_CODES): a stored entry with no description names the one that refused it.

oneOf.title: panelNoControls
oneOf.description: the plugin has no controls
oneOf.x-text: {plugin} has no control a panel can show, so it gets no panel ({message}).

oneOf.title: panelFamilyNotBacked
oneOf.description: the family has no panel backing
oneOf.x-text: {plugin}'s controls do not carry what that panel family needs ({message}); choose another family or none.

oneOf.title: panelLayoutInvalid
oneOf.description: the layout the plugin states is invalid
oneOf.x-text: The panel declared for {plugin} cannot be laid out ({message}); fix its panel declaration.

oneOf.title: panelOverrideUnavailable
oneOf.description: an override layer was given and no applier
oneOf.x-text: The {layers} override layers for {plugin} were not applied: this host cannot read overrides.

oneOf.title: panelOverrideRefused
oneOf.description: an override layer was refused
oneOf.x-text: The override layer {layer} ({name}) for {plugin} was refused: {message}. The layers below it still apply.

oneOf.title: panelOverrideDropped
oneOf.description: an override entry was dropped
oneOf.x-text: In override layer {layer} ({name}) for {plugin}, the entry for {control} was dropped: {message}.

oneOf.title: panelRoleDropped
oneOf.description: a role was dropped
oneOf.x-text: The role {entry} on {symbol} of {plugin} is not shown ({reason}); the control stays on its page.

oneOf.title: panelSkinDropped
oneOf.description: a skin field was dropped

oneOf.title: panelMeterRefused

oneOf.title: panelParamUnserved

oneOf.title: panelBarsTooFew

oneOf.title: panelBarsUnknownControl

oneOf.title: panelEasyRefused
oneOf.x-text: The Easy list of {plugin} was refused ({message}); the Easy page takes the rule instead.

PANEL_SKIN_CODES.description: The refusals of a skin package (omx-panel docs/skin-package.md): what the skin host and omx-panel's validator say when a skin's override, API or view is refused, each with its English sentence and the placeholders it fills; the surfaces read schema/codes.json and catalogs/<lang>.json, rendered from here (tools/codes-render.mjs).
PANEL_SKIN_CODES.x-why: The codes sheet schema/codes.json was a hand file beside the domain: its codes are omx-panel's words, so they live in its domain (sorting pass row V3).

oneOf.title: skinOverrideInvalid
oneOf.x-text: The override for {plugin} is invalid at {field} ({reason}); fix skin.json and reload the skin.

oneOf.title: skinOverrideEntryDropped
oneOf.x-text: The {field} entry {entry} for {plugin} was dropped ({reason}); the rest of the override still applies.

oneOf.title: skinApiMismatch
oneOf.x-text: This skin declares API {declared}, which this console does not support (it serves {supported}); the skin is not loaded.

oneOf.title: skinViewError
oneOf.x-text: The {field} entry {entry} is not in the package; reload it, or remove the skin if it keeps failing.

oneOf.title: skinViewLint
oneOf.x-text: The view {file} uses the disallowed word {word}; remove it and reload the skin.

PANEL_MODGUI_CODES.description: The refusals of the MOD GUI importer (omx-panel docs/modgui-import.md) and of a skin's MOD GUI script licence (panel.skin.modgui-licence), each with its English sentence and the placeholders it fills; rendered into schema/codes.json and catalogs/<lang>.json (tools/codes-render.mjs).
PANEL_MODGUI_CODES.x-why: The codes sheet schema/codes.json was a hand file beside the domain: its codes are omx-panel's words, so they live in its domain (sorting pass row V3).

oneOf.title: modguiNotFound
oneOf.x-text: No MOD GUI to import was found in {file} ({detail}); nothing was written.

oneOf.title: modguiTtlInvalid
oneOf.x-text: The bundle's {file} does not read as valid TTL ({detail}); fix it and import again.

oneOf.title: modguiNoLicence
oneOf.x-text: {file} states no licence ({detail}); add one to its bundle before its MOD GUI can be imported.

oneOf.title: modguiLicenceUnmapped
oneOf.x-text: The licence in {file} is not one this importer maps to an SPDX id ({detail}); add the mapping or change the licence.

oneOf.title: modguiLicenceRefused
oneOf.x-text: The licence in {file} is outside the allowed list ({detail}); the MOD GUI is not imported.

oneOf.title: modguiUnknownProperty
oneOf.x-text: {file} carries an unknown property ({detail}); remove it or correct it before importing.

oneOf.title: modguiPortUnknown
oneOf.x-text: {file} names a port that is not one of the plugin's own ports ({detail}); fix the symbol and import again.

oneOf.title: modguiImageNotFound
oneOf.x-text: {file} names an image that is not in the bundle's resources ({detail}); add the file or fix the reference.

oneOf.title: modguiPathEscape
oneOf.x-text: {file} names a path that resolves outside the bundle ({detail}); nothing is imported from outside the bundle.

oneOf.title: modguiTargetExists
oneOf.x-text: {file} already exists ({detail}); remove it first to import over it.

oneOf.title: skinModguiLicence
oneOf.x-text: The MOD GUI script for {plugin} is dropped: its licence {licence} is missing or not allowed.

PANEL_DISPLAY_AXES.description: The axis a panel description's display is drawn on (omx-panel docs/panel-layout.md "Displays and their axis"), in the order of their codes: describe serves it on every display as data, so no surface picks an axis by the display kind's name. omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs DISPLAY_AXES reads them, and the renderer reads the word.
PANEL_DISPLAY_AXES.x-why: The C renderer chose the log frequency axis by the display kind's name and a second client would have copied it; layout data comes via the description (owner ruling), so the axis is a word of the panel vocabulary.

oneOf.title: linear
oneOf.description: x and y on linear spans: a transfer curve's input and output dB on one span with the unity line, a bar's fill a linear fraction of its range
oneOf.x-text: A linear axis: a level in dB on a linear span.

oneOf.title: logFrequency
oneOf.description: x the frequency in Hz on a log axis, y the dB symmetric about 0 to the next 6 dB
oneOf.x-text: A log frequency axis: frequency in Hz on a log scale, level in dB about 0.

oneOf.title: time
oneOf.description: x the time in ms from 0 to the content's end, y the level in dB from the floor, -60, to 0 or the next 6 dB above a level
oneOf.x-text: A time axis: time in ms from 0, level in dB from the floor.
